name: Vehicle safety recalls matched across national registers on the manufacturer own campaign code

registers.us: United States, NHTSA. Code read out of the campaign remedy text.
registers.ca: Canada, Transport Canada Vehicle Recalls Database. Code is a published column.
registers.eu: European Union, Commission Safety Gate. Code is the companyRecallCode field.

rule: Exact match on the manufacturer own campaign code after identical normalisation on every side. Nothing is paired on brand and date.

excluded.why: Codes of three characters or fewer are not identifiers and were producing matches decades apart. They are excluded rather than published.
excluded.why_far: Pairs whose filings span more than 730 days. Manufacturers reuse short campaign codes across decades, so a match on the code alone can pair a 1983 recall with a 2025 one. They are published below under set_aside rather than dropped.

careful: A row here means three registers used the same manufacturer reference, not that the recalls are word for word identical. Each register keeps its own identifier and date so any row can be checked at source. Absence is not evidence: a register may hold the recall without stating the code.
licence: The filings belong to the regulators named above. The matching is ours and may be reused with attribution to carsmultiverse.com.
